negative_prompt: watermark, text signature, logo in corner, artist name, copyright notice, blurry, low resolution, bad anatomy, CGI, 3D digital render, smooth plastic doll skin, real live human photography, digital illustration, anime, cartoon, glossy toy finish, missing fingers, malformed hands, angry expression, modern electronic devices, smartphone, flat lighting
reconstruction_priority: tactile stop-motion craft materials — AI often homogenizes clay, wool fibers, corduroy, and tweed into generic digital CGI plastic
independent dual-character facial features — AI frequently blends the two puppet faces or mirrors their spectacles and hair
hand-held miniature open book interaction — AI often creates warped garbled hands or a fused book block
warm creamy depth of field with golden background bokeh — AI tends to oversharpen background elements and destroy the atmospheric stop-motion lighting
